claim_text: High-energy Fermi-LAT GRB photon arrival ranks show a shared energy-dependent timing residual.

provenance.evidence: Official HEASARC catalog and FSSC event/spacecraft files; per-file SHA-256 preserved in result.

preregistration.evidence: v2 configuration frozen before selected counts or statistic inspection.

synthetic_calibration.evidence: Dedicated injection recovery not yet executed for v2.

response_model.evidence: Tight aperture used; full Fermitools likelihood and gtsrcprob response not reproduced.

systematics.evidence: Frozen systematic grid remains pending because primary result is null-consistent.

multiple_testing.evidence: Exactly one frozen primary statistic evaluated.

ordinary_alternatives.evidence: Source-intrinsic spectral evolution remains an ordinary alternative.

independent_dataset.evidence: No independent instrument evaluated for this statistic.

limitations: No full likelihood association probability was computed.
The result is a kill, not evidence that all possible timing models are absent.
